claims.text: The four conversational QA models were selected based on their different model architectures and training strategies.
The selected models include BERT, GraphFlow, HAM, and ExCorD, each with unique approaches to handling conversational context.
BERT serves as a baseline model that concatenates previous turns, while GraphFlow uses a recurrent graph neural network to model dependencies.
HAM employs a history attention mechanism to select relevant previous turns, and ExCorD focuses on generating context-independent questions.
